description: Defines a base class for OpenMax components, including callback forwarding, event management, and parameter handling, specifically for Raspberry Pi 4 platform.

classes.name: OpenMaxComponentBase
classes.description: A base class managing OMX callback forwarding, event handling, and parameter configuration for OpenMax components on Raspberry Pi.

methods.name: GetInputPortParam
methods.description: Retrieves parameters for the input port.

methods.name: GetOutputPortParam
methods.description: Retrieves parameters for the output port.

methods.name: SendCommand
methods.description: Sends a command to the OMX component.

methods.name: WaitForCommandCompletion
methods.description: Waits for a command to complete.

methods.name: SendCommandAndWaitForCompletion
methods.description: Sends a command and waits for its completion.
